items.title: OpenAI plans to release GPT-5.1, GPT-5.1 Reasoning, and GPT-5.1 Pro
items.description: OpenAI is preparing the GPT-5.1 family for public rollout. This includes GPT-5.1 (base), GPT-5.1 Reasoning, and GPT-5.1 Pro for those who pay a $200 monthly subscription. [...]

items.title: GlassWorm malware returns on OpenVSX with 3 new VSCode extensions
items.description: The GlassWorm malware campaign, which impacted the OpenVSX and Visual Studio Code marketplaces last month, has returned with three new VSCode extensions that have already been downloaded over 10,000 times. [...]

items.title: Still on Windows 10? Enroll in free ESU before next week’s Patch Tuesday
items.description: With the first Patch Tuesday following Windows 10's end of support approaching next week, users who continue to run the operating system should enroll in the Extended Security Updates (ESU) program to remain protected against newly discovered security vulnerabilities. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Uncovers 'Whisper Leak' Attack That Identifies AI Chat Topics in Encrypted Traffic
items.description: Microsoft has disclosed details of a novel side-channel attack targeting remote language models that could enable a passive adversary with capabilities to observe network traffic to glean details about model conversation topics despite encryption protections under certain circumstances. items.title: Seven QNAP Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Exploited at Pwn2Own 2025 Now Patched
items.description: QNAP has addressed seven critical zero-day vulnerabilities in its network-attached storage (NAS) operating systems, following their successful exploitation by security researchers at Pwn2Own Ireland 2025. items.title: Google Maps Adds Feature for Businesses to Report Ransom Demands Over Reviews
items.description: Scammers are targeting businesses with a new extortion scheme, and Google Maps is fighting back with a dedicated reporting tool. Google has introduced a feature that allows business owners to report ransom demands directly to malicious actors who threaten them with fake negative reviews.
